subject: Java Developer with Strong React – Plano, TX – Aaron Ramirez (C2C/W2)
body:
Hi Arfin,

I saw your LinkedIn post for the Java Developer with Strong React role in Plano, TX and would like to be considered. My tailored resume is attached.

- 10+ years delivering enterprise web platforms for Walmart Global Tech, IBM/AEP, and HCSC with React as the strongest skill: React.js, TypeScript, Redux, component libraries, and performance work on applications serving hundreds of thousands of daily users.
- Java 11/17+ with Spring Boot: REST microservices, Kafka event-driven integrations, Hibernate/JPA, and SQL Server / PostgreSQL / Oracle data behind those React front ends.
- AWS and Azure deployments with Docker and GitHub Actions / Jenkins CI/CD; Jest, React Testing Library, JUnit, and Cypress testing.
- Based in the Dallas area, so Plano onsite is local for me.

Available on C2C or W2. Glad to discuss rate and start date this week.

Best regards,
Aaron David Ramírez Lezama
